title: Build product runtime HITL and Stripe validation system
objective: Convert the product governance framework into executable runtime assets: product registry, pricing matrix, Stripe walkthrough validation, delivery validation, HITL signoff, billing lifecycle, support, upsells, recovery, and REAL/PARTIAL/PRETEND evidence classification.

scope.products_source: T4H 50 automated products via agents CSV uploaded in ChatGPT session; bridge worker should ingest canonical product list from asset/source registry if present, otherwise request attachment sync.
commercial_configurations: customer choice stack: Microsoft, Google, AWS, Azure, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Supabase, Vercel as applicable
bespoke mixed stack with custom pricing and operational support

acceptance_criteria: Every product has a canonical registry row.
Every product has delivery mode classified as downloadable_asset, saas_runtime, managed_service, api, report, assessment, or bespoke_mix.
Every product has Stripe product/price/payment-link/subscription mapping or explicit blocker.
Every product has customer journey scenarios from choice to cancellation.
Every product has HITL approval state with machine-readable rejection reasons.
Every product has runtime validation records and evidence references.
REAL/PARTIAL/PRETEND classification is calculated from evidence, not manually asserted.
Bridge writes receipt to receipts/runtime/ and audit.log/reality ledger where available.

definition_of_done.partial: Any missing runtime, billing, HITL, support, recovery, or telemetry evidence.
definition_of_done.pretend: Static claims, untested pages, missing billing proof, missing delivery proof, or no receipts.
